escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, the instant a leader deploys her squad inside a vast dark hangar at night): Nexa stands well to the RIGHT of the frame, her face centred at about 70% of the frame width, framed from the waist up, a heroic medium shot. Her LEFT hand (on the right side of the frame) is raised palm up at chest height, about thirty centimetres in front of her face, and on her palm burns a FIST-SIZED CORE of azure-white light, the brightest thing in the frame. From the core, four streams of azure light fly away from her, back and to the right into the depth of the hangar. LIGHT: the core is the only key light on her: hard, from below and to the right, so the right side of her face, her glasses, her raised hand and the white plates of her shoulder and chest glow azure, while the far side of her face falls into deep shadow with the nose shadow legible on her cheek. NO fill light, NO front light. A low cool rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulder. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about two meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened, she does not lean toward the lens; her head is about one quarter of the frame height, her shoulders clearly wider than two head-widths. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and she looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with composed determination, lips gently closed without a smile, gaze intent and direct, razor-thin focus on her eyes. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate on her left side exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small gold earrings as in the identity anchor, NO watch, NO bracelet, NO ring. THE SPARKS, copied EXACTLY from their two references, each smaller than her head, all above her waist, never arranged in a symmetric arc: the Reports Spark hovers just above the core on her palm, sharp, lit from below by the core, its bar-chart model glowing, pointing at the tallest bar; the Research Spark is PERCHED ON HER RIGHT SHOULDER (on the left side of her body in the frame), one small hand resting on her shoulder plate, holding its magnifying glass to its side and peering toward the core, half in her shadow, sharp. Both Sparks are lit only by the scene light and obey the same depth of field as everything else, never a clean product shot. FAR AWAY in the haze, EXACTLY THREE distant Sparks (FIVE Sparks total, never more): ONE four metres behind her at frame-right above shoulder height; ONE five metres behind her near the far-right edge at chest height; ONE six metres behind her partly occluded by the frame-right edge of her hair, with only its blurred visor visible. All three are the same figures as the two Spark references, small, unequal in size, clearly out of focus, and stay entirely to the right of Nexa; each catches one stream. Further back, a long row of large round cold practical lights hangs across the hangar, melted into big soft bokeh discs. Thin haze catches the streams and the core. GEOGRAPHY: the Research Spark on her right shoulder is the leftmost lit element of the whole frame and its left edge stays at about 58% of the frame width; her elbow, hair and torso all stay to the right of that boundary; nothing lit, no Spark, no stream and no part of her body appears to the left of it. The LEFT half of the frame is calm, dark, empty hangar space with soft haze, no objects, no streams, no Sparks, no people. The hangar is a believable monumental physical space: structural ribs and distant gantries melt into the shadows and bokeh, not a plain black backdrop. Photographic skin with natural pores, tiny facial asymmetries, real stray hairs and physical fabric and ceramic textures, never waxy skin or beauty retouch. The face is lit by azure-white light, not a uniform blue wash. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No logos of any other brand, no readable text.

fenomeno.esServicio: Agent Ops: Nexa supervisa y despliega agentes de investigación y reportes, cada uno con una tarea; la luz hace visible la delegación y su coordinación

nota: Prueba local solicitada por el operador: Nano Banana 2.1 directo Google, 4K y thinking high. Referencias aprobadas: identidad facial v2, expresión, traje y lentes por catálogo; NX7d sólo como calibración visual, no ancla de rostro ni imagen enviada al modelo. Luz azul/blanco; sin nuevo acento en esta toma.
